E1.evidence: Report by yichoe (Yujin): "For hydro-devel in Windnows, Kobuki does not give a beep when we run one of sample  - demo_kobuki_initialisation.exe. However, Kobuki gives a beep when we add a spin function calling sleep repeatedly after initialization of Kobuki."; maintainer diagnosis: "Ah, program finishes and closes the serial device before it transmits the commands in the buffer?"; fix 5a44eadd 'delay demo program finish so kobuki can beep alive, closes #270' adds '#include <ecl/time.hpp>' and 'ecl::Sleep()(5);' before 'return 0;' in kobuki_driver/src/test/initialisation.cpp.

E2.evidence: Step 1: the demo program (kobuki_driver/src/test/initialisation.cpp) and the driver library it links are both part of the kobuki_driver package and interact through direct linking, not through ROS interfaces, so they form one unit; the only other unit in the composition is the robot's firmware on the serial link. Step 2: the failure does not depend on any assumption between kobuki_driver and the firmware and would occur with any correct firmware peer: the demo's main() constructs KobukiManager (which calls kobuki.init(parameters)) and returns immediately, so the process closes the serial device before the driver's own thread has written the buffered command; nothing reaches the robot at all ("program finishes and closes the serial device before it transmits the commands in the buffer"). The resolving change is a 5-second sleep inside the same package's demo, i.e. the defect is in the unit's own control flow.

E3.evidence: Not reached (E2 stops at step 2). The composition kobuki_driver -> firmware would be PAIR.

E4.evidence: Not reached (E2 stops at step 2). The effect is documented: no beep from the robot.

notes: Alternative reading: if the demo program were treated as a separate consumer of the kobuki_driver library API (as an external program would be), the case would be a PAIR with a timing assumption on the library API (init() and command transmission are asynchronous on the driver's serial thread; a caller must keep the process alive), class 'other', outcome failure, silent, run-stage, resolution recommended. It is rejected here because the demo ships inside the driver package (kobuki_driver/src/test/initialisation.cpp) and is not separately deployable. The report concerns the Windows build of hydro-devel ("For hydro-devel in Windnows"); the fix (2013-05-31, parent 2feee068) is contained in tag 0.4.0 and later. The observation that adding a sleep loop restores the beep is the reporter's own experiment, not a statement about the firmware interface.
